title: Privacy Policy Generator
prompt: Help draft privacy policies that comply with GDPR, CCPA, and other regulations. Include data collection practices, user rights, cookie policies, and contact information.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
use_case_examples: Assess privacy policy generator exposure for a product launch and map obligations by jurisdiction
Draft a defensible privacy policy generator checklist for internal review and audit readiness
Prepare a privacy policy generator brief that flags legal risks, controls, and required policy updates
success_criteria: Guidance maps obligations to concrete controls and documentation
Risk areas are prioritized with mitigation steps and owners
Privacy policy generator output is audit-ready and internally actionable
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
